# David Cervantes — AI Product Leader, Designer & Strategist

> David Cervantes is an AI product leader, designer and strategist with 25 years of experience turning complex software into products people actually use. He designs conversational and Reactive AI systems end-to-end — from first user question to working code — across fintech, healthcare, retail media, real estate, construction, and consumer apps. Based in Orlando, FL. Available for select contract engagements.

## About

- [About David Cervantes](https://www.uxokdc.com/About): Background, approach, and areas of expertise — product strategy, UX research, design systems, Intent-Centered Design, and AI-native product design.
- [Experience](https://www.uxokdc.com/Experience): Career timeline and design leadership across AI, SaaS, e-commerce, fintech, healthcare, and enterprise — from individual contributor to strategy.

## Writing

- [Intent-Centered Design](https://www.uxokdc.com/Intent-Centered-Design): David Cervantes' method for designing AI products around the user's intent — the thing the person is trying to accomplish — rather than around the model's capabilities or a generic chat box. Surfaces the right capability at the moment the user forms a goal, and builds trust and human hand-off into the design.
- [Reactive AI](https://www.uxokdc.com/Reactive-AI): AI that responds to the state of the work — surfacing an insight, warning, or option the instant it becomes relevant, without the user having to ask, while staying explainable and correctable.
- [Conversational Flow Mapping](https://www.uxokdc.com/Conversational-Flow-Mapping): designing an AI conversation like a product flow — mapping the user's intents, the turns, the recovery points, and where it hands to a human, before writing the prompt.

## Selected case studies

- [TraderVault LM](https://www.uxokdc.com/TraderVault%20LM%20Case%20Study): A conversational AI trading platform designed the way active traders actually think — surfacing patterns as they form, framing odds honestly, and tracing every signal to its source.
- [TintoProps](https://www.uxokdc.com/TintoProps%20Case%20Study): Colombia's first AI-native real estate portal — property search powered by conversational AI.
- [Construct AI](https://www.uxokdc.com/Construct%20AI%20Case%20Study): AI project intelligence for construction teams — proactive insights and voice-first workflows for field and office.
- [ULTRA](https://www.uxokdc.com/ULTRA%20Case%20Study): A social feed built on sentiment filters and blockchain transparency — designing trust and control back into social media.
- [NESTRE](https://www.uxokdc.com/NESTRE%20Case%20Study): A cognitive-training facility rebuilt for mobile — 90% smooth-navigation and 85% professional-feel scores in usability testing.
- [Ulta Beauty Media](https://www.uxokdc.com/ULTA%20BEAUTY%20Case%20Study): A self-serve retail-media advertising platform built on first-party data for non-technical media buyers.
- [Yelo](https://www.uxokdc.com/YELO%20Case%20Study): A campus-only ride-hailing network — 90% safety satisfaction, 25% reduction in wait times.
- [AI Genius](https://www.uxokdc.com/AI%20Genius%20Case%20Study): A freelance intelligence platform applying AI to project-based work.
